protocol_name: CT3 locked 149-case symbolic model one-time final evaluation
approval_source: User instruction to freeze the current formal model roles and final-test metrics
threshold_interpretation: Predeclared project research-reporting thresholds only; they are not nuclear safety or licensing limits.
failure_rule: Any failed threshold is reported as a limitation. It does not permit model reselection, refitting or threshold revision using the final cases.
uncertainty_rule: Report 95% descriptive similarity-group bootstrap intervals using 10000 resamples.
final_evaluation_rule: Open all 50 cases once, evaluate every element with both frozen roles, create the fixed evidence package and refuse a second completed execution.
